lines.en: label toukastreets1:
scene sky
I decide to mix things up for a change and start aimlessly walking around the city as soon as I wake up.
lines.zh: 我决定换换花样，一醒来就开始在城里漫无目的地闲逛。

lines.en: Now, I’m sure you’re thinking that aimlessly walking around is kind of just my thing.
lines.zh: 我敢说你这会儿在想：漫无目的地闲逛本来不就是我的风格吗。

lines.en: But the whole “mixing it up” part lies in the fact that I normally can’t do that until I’ve at least let the day’s misery sink in.
lines.zh: 但「换花样」的部分在于：我平常得先让一天的丧气浸透了我，才走得动。

lines.en: But here I am, on a surprisingly sunny morning in the middle of winter, successfully avoiding that exact misery.
lines.zh: 可今天我就在这儿——隆冬里一个难得晴朗的早晨——成功避开了那份丧气。

lines.en: And hey, I don’t even think I’ll wind up running into Yumi this time around since I’m pretty sure she’s incapable of waking up this early.
lines.zh: 而且，嘿，我觉得这回我不会撞上 Yumi 了——我很确定她起不了这么早。

lines.en: I have absolutely nothing to base that on other than that she’s just Yumi.
lines.zh: 我这判断毫无依据，只因为她是 Yumi。

lines.en: But I’m pretty sure that alone is enough.
lines.zh: 不过我很确定，光凭这点就够了。

lines.en: : Accept my money, blasted peasant drink dispenser!
lines.zh: : 收下我的钱，你这该死的平民饮料贩卖机！

lines.en: scene toukavending1
Oh, it appears I’ve run into the exact opposite of Yumi.
lines.zh: 哦，看来我撞上的是 Yumi 的反面。

lines.en: Not so much in attitude since both of them seem to vehemently dislike me on at least a surface level-
lines.zh: 倒不是态度上相反——她俩表面上好像都极度讨厌我——

lines.en: And also not so much in terms of adaptability or socializing with their peers...
lines.zh: 也不是在适应力或与同龄人相处方面相反……

lines.en: Actually, now that I think about it, Touka and Yumi might have more in common than they realize.
lines.zh: 其实，这么一想，Touka 和 Yumi 的共同点可能比她们自己意识到的还多。

lines.en: Just one of them is poor and one of them is rich. So yeah.
lines.zh: 只是一个穷一个富而已。就这样。

lines.en: But despite being rich, Touka seems to be fighting with a “peasant drink dispenser” or, as you and I would call it, a vending machine.
lines.zh: 不过，尽管 Touka 很有钱，她此刻正在跟一台「平民饮料贩卖机」较劲——也就是你我所称的「自动贩卖机」。

lines.en: I should probably call out to her and see what the issue is...
lines.zh: 我大概该叫她一声，看看出了什么事……

lines.en: : Having trouble there?
lines.zh: : 遇到麻烦了？

lines.en: scene toukavending2
: Back away, heathen! This is my battle!
lines.zh: : 退开，野蛮人！这是我的战斗！

lines.en: : Well okay then. See you later.
lines.zh: : 那行吧。回头见。

lines.en: scene toukavending3
: Wait! Stay.
lines.zh: : 等等！别走。

lines.en: : I need your help and I did not realize it was you who was approaching.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮忙，刚才没认出走近的是你。

lines.en: : What are you doing out and about so early?
lines.zh: : 你这么早在外面晃什么？

lines.en: : I’d ask you the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我还想问呢。

lines.en: : Actually, why are you walking around in general? Don’t you have a chauffeur to bring you to...random vending machines or whatever?
lines.zh: : 其实，你为什么非要走路？你不是有司机送你去……随便什么贩卖机之类的地方吗？

lines.en: scene toukavending4
: I do...but in an attempt to become one with society, Mother has asked that I explore the area and attempt to blend in.
lines.zh: : 有……但为了「融入社会」，母亲要我自己走走这片区域、试着融入进去。

lines.en: : Well you’re doing a great job by yelling at a large appliance. Keep it up.
lines.zh: : 你对着一台大家电大喊大叫，干得可真棒。继续。

lines.en: scene toukavending5
: How do I make it like my money?! It seems fundamentally simple, but it’s actually very confusing!
lines.zh: : 我该怎么让它收我的钱？！这事看着明明很简单，实际上却难极了！

lines.en: : It’s really not. It’s probably just a bad bill or-
lines.zh: : 真没那么难。多半只是你这张纸币有问题，或者——

lines.en: Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: Touka is extremely out of touch with modern society.
lines.zh: Touka 对现代社会极度脱节。

lines.en: This obviously means that I must take advantage of her.
lines.zh: 这显然意味着，我必须占她便宜。

lines.en: : Did you say the chant?
lines.zh: : 你念咒了吗？

lines.en: scene toukavending6
: I’m sorry, the what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，什么咒？

lines.en: : The chant.
lines.zh: : 咒语啊。

lines.en: : These vending machines are voice activated and you need to talk to them or they won’t accept your money.
lines.zh: : 这些贩卖机是声控的，你得跟它们说话，不然它们不收你的钱。

lines.en: : Voice activated? But they look so outdated compared to the high-tech ones we have in our game room.
lines.zh: : 声控？可跟我们游戏室里那些高科技的比，它们看着好过时。

lines.en: : I guess they’re a little- wait, you have vending machines in your house?
lines.zh: : 我猜它们是有点——等等，你家里有贩卖机？

lines.en: : There are machines at the dorm as well. Are they not a standard appliance in commoner households?
lines.zh: : 宿舍里也有。贩卖机难道不是平民家庭的标配家电吗？

lines.en: : They-
lines.zh: : 它们——

lines.en: scene toukavending7
: Wait! Before you answer that, please teach me the chant!
lines.zh: : 等等！回答那个问题之前，先教我咒语！

lines.en: : This is the furthest I’ve walked since my family's last vacation to Kyoto and I am beginning to become dehydrated!
lines.zh: : 这是我家上次京都度假以来我走得最远的一次，我开始脱水了！

lines.en: : Hmm...I wonder how it went again.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我记得是怎麽念来着。

lines.en: : Perhaps there’s something that could jog my memory.
lines.zh: : 也许有什么东西能「唤起」我的记忆。

lines.en: scene toukavending8
: Are you...attempting to have me bribe you?
lines.zh: : 你这是……想让我贿赂你？

lines.en: : I may be extremely well off, but even I’m not willing to just hand out money if that’s what you’re implying.
lines.zh: : 我虽然很有钱，可你要是指望我白给钱，那我也没那么大方。

lines.en: : I also accept personal favors.
lines.zh: : 我也接受「私人的人情」。

lines.en: scene toukavending2
: Just tell me the chant, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 快告诉我咒语，Sensei！

lines.en: : Fine, fine.
lines.zh: : 行行。

lines.en: : First, you need to raise your right hand in the air as if you’re about to cast a spell on the machine.
lines.zh: : 首先，你得把右手举到空中，像要对这台机器施法一样。

lines.en: scene toukavending6
: There is a visual element to this as well?
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿还有「视觉」环节？

lines.en: : Yeah. These machines also double as security cameras, so they can see everything you do.
lines.zh: : 对。这些机器同时兼作监控摄像头，所以它们看得见你做的一切。

lines.en: : How utterly terrifying. But I suppose if that is what must be done...
lines.zh: : 太可怕了。不过，要是非这样不可的话……

lines.en: I don’t know if I’m more impressed by Touka’s gullibility or my own ability to come up with such a fluid lie without even thinking.
lines.zh: 我都说不清，我更佩服 Touka 的「好骗」，还是我自己「想都不用想就能编出这么顺溜的谎话」的本事。

lines.en: Either way, this is awesome.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这太爽了。

lines.en: scene toukavending9
: Okay! I am now in position!
lines.zh: : 好了！我摆好姿势了！

lines.en: : Will this do?
lines.zh: : 这样行吗？

lines.en: : Yup. Perfect.
lines.zh: : 行。完美。

lines.en: : Now all you need to do is politely ask the machine to accept your money.
lines.zh: : 现在你只需礼貌地请这台机器收下你的钱。

lines.en: : If you want, you can just repeat after me.
lines.zh: : 你要愿意，跟着我说就行。

lines.en: : If you’d be so inclined, I would very much appreciate it.
lines.zh: : 若你肯屈尊教我，我将感激不尽。

lines.en: : Then-
lines.zh: : 那么——

lines.en: : Hear my call, peasant drink dispenser.
lines.zh: : 听我号令，平民饮料贩卖机。

lines.en: : Hear my call, peasant drink dispenser!
lines.zh: : 听我号令，平民饮料贩卖机！

lines.en: : I, Touma Tsukiyama of the Tsukiyama family-
lines.zh: : 我，月山家的 Touma Tsukiyama——

lines.en: : I, Touka Tsukioka of the Tsukioka family-
lines.zh: : 我，月冈家的 Touka Tsukioka——

lines.en: : Ask for nourishment-
lines.zh: : 请求滋养——

lines.en: : Ask for nourishment-
lines.zh: : 请求滋养——

lines.en: : And surrender my rights and my body to the man beside me.
lines.zh: : 并将我的权利和身体交给我身旁的这位男士。

lines.en: : And surrender my-
lines.zh: : 并将我的——

lines.en: scene toukavending10
: WHAT DO YOU THINK YOU’RE MAKING ME SAY?!
lines.zh: : 你想让我说什么？！

lines.en: So close.
lines.zh: 就差一点。

lines.en: scene toukavending11
: Mmm...
: Wait, are you crying?
lines.zh: : 等等，你哭了？

lines.en: : I trusted you and you took advantage of me.
lines.zh: : 我那么信任你，你却利用了我。

lines.en: : I was just messing with you. There’s no reason to cry.
lines.zh: : 我只是逗你玩。没理由哭。

lines.en: : Here, give me the money.
lines.zh: : 给，把钱给我。

lines.en: scene toukavending12
: AND NOW I AM BEING ROBBED!
lines.zh: : 这下我要被抢了！

lines.en: : MOTHER! HELP!
lines.zh: : 母亲！救命！

lines.en: : I’m not robbing you...I just want to see if there’s a problem with your money.
lines.zh: : 我不是抢你……我只是想看看你的钱是不是有问题。

lines.en: scene toukavending13
: Do you promise not to take it and run away?
lines.zh: : 你保证不拿了就跑吗？

lines.en: : On most days, my above average athletic ability would allow me to catch up with you, but my dehydration has made me very weak and I do not think I would be able to today.
lines.zh: : 换作平常，我超出常人的运动能力还能追上你，可脱水让我虚弱得很，今天我怕是追不动了。

lines.en: : I’m not going to run away with one bill. I am not that poor, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我不会拿着一张纸币就跑的。我没穷到那份上，Touka。

lines.en: : Also, what would it even matter if I did? You’re made of money.
lines.zh: : 再说，我就算跑了又怎样？你钱多得是。

lines.en: : It’s the principle of it. I refuse to fail even during times like this. Tsukiokas always come out on top.
lines.zh: : 这是原则问题。就算在这种时候，我也拒绝失败。月冈家的人永远是赢家。

lines.en: : Just give me the note, Touka.
lines.zh: : 把纸币给我，Touka。

lines.en: scene toukavending12
: Fine! But only because you used the right name this time!
lines.zh: : 好吧！但只因为你这次叫对了名字！

lines.en: scene toukavending14
Touka hands me the note she’s trying to use and, just as I suspected, it’s in too bad of shape for the machine to take it.
lines.zh: Touka 把她想用却没用的纸币递给我——正如我所料，它破得没法让机器吞进去。

lines.en: It’s actually so bad that I’m a little surprised someone of her status would even be carrying it.
lines.zh: 破到这地步，我甚至有点惊讶：她这种身份的人怎么会随身带着它。

lines.en: : Is my money broken?
lines.zh: : 我的钱坏了吗？

lines.en: : Where did you get this?
lines.zh: : 你从哪儿弄来的？

lines.en: : The tiny, yet surprisingly endowed girl in our class gave it to me when I bumped into her and asked her where I could purchase a drink just moments ago.
lines.zh: : 刚才我撞上我们班那个娇小却意外丰满的女孩、问她哪儿能买饮料时，她给我的。

lines.en: : Uta? I mean, it makes sense that her money would be in this condition, but why not just use your own?
lines.zh: : Uta？我是说，她的钱破成这样倒也合理，可你为什么不用自己的？

lines.en: : I left my coin purse in my room out of fear that I may be attacked during my first ever walk among “the people.”
lines.zh: : 我把零钱包落在房间里了——因为我怕生平第一次「走进人群」时会遭袭击。

lines.en: : Why even leave your room if you’re so afraid of things like that?
lines.zh: : 你既然那么怕这种事，干嘛还出房门？

lines.en: scene toukavending15
: The constant pressure to blend in and the strive for both your and my mother’s approval as a normal girl!
lines.zh: : 是因为「融入」的持续压力，以及为了成为你和我母亲眼中「正常女孩」而努力！

lines.en: : Wow. That was a surprisingly honest answer.
lines.zh: : 哇。这回答意外坦诚。

lines.en: scene toukavending16
: I utterly despise lying and found no reason to in this situation.
lines.zh: : 我极度厌恶撒谎，这种情形下也没理由撒。

lines.en: : Just tell me my money is expired and I will be on my way.
lines.zh: : 你只管告诉我我的钱「过期」了，我就走人。

lines.en: : Hah...
: Move over.
lines.zh: : 让开。

lines.en: scene toukavending17
: I beg your pardon? Why should I have to give up my spot when I arrived first and-
lines.zh: : 你说什么？凭什么我得让位？明明是我先到的，而且——

lines.en: scene black
: Hey! What do you think you’re doing!
lines.zh: : 嘿！你以为你在干什么？

lines.en: : Help! I am being attacked!
lines.zh: : 救命！我被袭击了！

lines.en: I move Touka aside and slip some of the coins in my pocket into the machine.
lines.zh: 我把 Touka 拨到一边，把兜里几枚硬币塞进了机器。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你要什么？

lines.en: : Wait...are you-
lines.zh: : 等等……你该不会——

lines.en: : Just a water is-
lines.zh: : 就来瓶水——

lines.en: : Green tea? Got it.
lines.zh: : 绿茶？好。

lines.en: : Why even ask me if you’re just going to do whatever you please?!
lines.zh: : 既然你反正都自作主张，干嘛还问我？！

lines.en: scene toukavending18
: Sip...
: This is normally the part where you say “Thank you.”
lines.zh: : 这时候你一般该说声「谢谢」。

lines.en: : Sip...
: Well fuck you then.
lines.zh: : 行，那就去你的。

lines.en: scene toukavending19
: Oh, stop. There’s no need for such hostility. I’m extremely thankful.
lines.zh: : 哦，别这样。没必要这么敌对。我非常感激。

lines.en: : I just believed that there may have been some sort of ulterior motive for a moment, so I was protecting myself.
lines.zh: : 我只是有一瞬觉得你可能有什么「不良企图」，所以在自我保护。

lines.en: : Without you, I would be significantly less hydrated. You have affected me greatly.
lines.zh: : 没有你，我的「水分」会少得多。你极大地影响了我。

lines.en: : Even if you directly ignored my plea for water in place of this...boxed tea beverage.
lines.zh: : 尽管你直接无视了我「要水」的请求、换成了这个……盒装茶饮料。

lines.en: : Have you never had boxed tea before?
lines.zh: : 你从没喝过盒装茶？

lines.en: scene toukavending20
: I have not. Our family has a tea master who lives at the manor, and he would abhor the idea of me drinking something like this.
lines.zh: : 没有。我们家有一位住在宅邸里的茶艺大师，他会极其厌恶我喝这种东西。

lines.en: : It is not nearly as bad as it looks, though. So I would like to thank you once more for making a choice that only appeared bad at first.
lines.zh: : 不过它没看起来那么难喝。所以我要再次感谢你，做了一个「只是起初看着糟糕」的选择。

lines.en: : You’re...welcome?
lines.zh: : 不……客气？

lines.en: scene toukavending21
: I...would not reject the idea of you coming to the manor to experience a proper tea ceremony, if that would at all repay you for your graciousness today.
lines.zh: : 我……不反对你来大宅体验一场正宗的茶道——如果这能多少报答你今天的善意。

lines.en: : Well thank you for not rejecting it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢你不反对。

lines.en: : That’s not really an invitation, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这还算不上正式邀请。

lines.en: : R-Right! It is not.
lines.zh: : 对——对！不是邀请。

lines.en: scene toukavending22
: Sip...
: You feel pretty awkward right now, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你现在觉得挺尴尬的，对吧？

lines.en: scene toukavending23
: Do you not?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I’ve received plenty of private lessons from teachers in the past, but I have never sat with any of them so casually in public.
lines.zh: : 我以前也接受过不少老师的私教课，但从没跟哪位在公共场合这么随意地坐过。

lines.en: : Being seen out here makes me feel as if I’m...exposed. And having a...man beside me-
lines.zh: : 就这么被人看见，让我觉得自己好像……「暴露」了。而且旁边还有个……男人——

lines.en: : It feels rather immoral, does it not?
lines.zh: : 这感觉相当不道德，不是吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I spend most of my days surrounded by [teenage]girls, so I’m pretty used to it.
lines.zh: : 不太觉得。我大多数日子都被[未成年]女孩围着，早就习惯了。

lines.en: : Yes, but that’s on[school] grounds. It’s entirely different.
lines.zh: : 可那是在学校里。性质完全不同。

lines.en: : Not always. You’ve literally seen me at the dojo with Ayane before.
lines.zh: : 也不尽然。你明明在道场见过我和 Ayane 在一起。

lines.en: scene toukavending24
: Well...yes! But after hearing the things she has said about her...feelings for you, I have come to terms with your relationship being...different.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛……是！不过听她说起她对你的……感情之后，我已经接受了你们的关系……「不一样」这个事实。

lines.en: : I don’t know what she told you, but you’d probably be better off not believing it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她跟你说了什么，但你最好都别信。

lines.en: scene toukavending25
: I will do just that, but...it does not exactly remedy my discomfort.
lines.zh: : 我会照做的，但……这并不能完全缓解我的不自在。

lines.en: : I realize that I’m likely just being reserved based on my own personal experiences and stigmas, but I can not exactly help it just yet.
lines.zh: : 我意识到，我多半只是出于自己的经历和成见而有所保留，可我眼下还没法完全克服。

lines.en: : With your help, though...I can see myself getting at least partially better.
lines.zh: : 不过，有你的帮助……我觉得自己至少能好一点点。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t count on me too much.
lines.zh: : 我劝你别太指望我。

lines.en: : Just keep being a weird rich girl and I’ll probably keep bumping into you out of a mix of coincidence and curiosity.
lines.zh: : 你就接着当你的怪咖富家女，而我多半也会出于「巧合加好奇」，继续撞见你。

lines.en: scene toukavending26
: Forgive me if I am misunderstanding, but the latter half of that made it sound as if you are interested in me.
lines.zh: : 如果我理解错了请见谅，可你后半句听着，好像你对我「有意思」。

lines.en: : I am.
lines.zh: : 是有。

lines.en: scene toukavending27
: You are?
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : You’re weird. It’s funny.
lines.zh: : 你很怪。很好玩。

lines.en: : I’m...funny?
lines.zh: : 我……好玩？

lines.en: : That’s not exactly what I said, but okay.
lines.zh: : 我不完全是那么说的，不过行吧。

lines.en: : I...I see.
lines.zh: : 我……我明白了。

lines.en: : Well then...if we happen to bump into each other again on our respective morning walks...I wouldn’t mind doing more things like this.
lines.zh: : 那么……要是我们哪天各自的晨间散步又撞上了……我不介意再多做点这样的事。

lines.en: : Since we are both curious about each others’ lifestyles, of course. Not because we’re interested in each other as people.
lines.zh: : 当然，是鉴于我们都对彼此的生活方式感到好奇。而不是因为我们对「彼此这个人」有意思。

lines.en: : I don’t really need to know much about your lifestyle, but I wouldn’t mind showing you a little more about how “commoners” live.
lines.zh: : 我倒不太需要了解你的生活方式，不过我不介意多带你看看「平民」是怎么过的。

lines.en: : You should be aware that I’m probably going to mess with you a lot, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你得有心理准备，我多半会经常捉弄你。

lines.en: scene toukavending28
: Why?! What have I done to deserve this?!
lines.zh: : 为什么？！我做了什么要受这个？！

lines.en: : Nothing in particular, but that’s just how things are going to be for a while.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的，但接下来一阵子就是这样了。

lines.en: : I show you the ropes. You say something unintentionally funny. I tease you about it.
lines.zh: : 我带你见世面。你说出一句无心的蠢话。我拿来打趣你。

lines.en: : Everyone wins.
lines.zh: : 皆大欢喜。

lines.en: : This really doesn’t sound like an ideal student-teacher relationship to me...
lines.zh: : 这听着真不像什么理想的师生关系……

lines.en: : The “ideal” part comes later. We’re still in the beginning phase.
lines.zh: : 「理想」的部分在后头。我们现在还在「初始阶段」。

lines.en: scene toukavending29
: So...you are only acting this way toward me for the time being and will eventually become more of a traditional role model?
lines.zh: : 所以……你现在这么对我只是暂时的，以后会变成更「传统」的良师益友？

lines.en: : Sure. That’s one way to put it.
lines.zh: : 对。可以这么理解。

lines.en: An incredibly wrong way to put it, but still one way.
lines.zh: 这是个错得离谱的理解，但好歹也算一种理解。

lines.en: : I see. So this would be what you would call a...trial period?
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那这就是你们说的……「试用期」？

lines.en: : Call it whatever makes you comfortable.
lines.zh: : 你舒服怎么叫就怎么叫。

lines.en: scene toukavending30
: A trial period it is, then...
lines.zh: : 那就叫「试用期」吧……

lines.en: : Though, I have a lot more to learn than just figuring out how to operate various drink machines.
lines.zh: : 不过，我要学的可不止「怎么操作各种饮料机」。

lines.en: : So, if you’re willing to continue guiding me when it is convenient for you to do so...I’d be inclined to accept.
lines.zh: : 所以，只要你方便的时候愿意继续指点我……我就愿意接受。

lines.en: : I can’t say I’ll be particularly happy about it since your methods are still rather confusing to me...
lines.zh: : 我不能说我会多开心，因为你的法子还是让我很费解……

lines.en: : But I suppose that nothing has gotten dramatically worse since I’ve started learning under you just yet.
lines.zh: : 但我想，自从开始受你指点以来，情况至少没有明显变糟。

lines.en: : I’m sure it will. That’s normally how things go.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定会的。事情一般都那样发展。

lines.en: : But life without problems is no life at all.
lines.zh: : 但没有波折的人生，根本不叫人生。

lines.en: scene toukavending31
: I suppose that much I’d have to agree with.
lines.zh: : 这一点我倒不得不同意。

lines.en: : The true hardships have yet to come. And I must be prepared for them when they do.
lines.zh: : 真正的磨难还没到来。而等它们来了，我必须做好准备。

lines.en: : Right now, I’m nothing more than a girl with a fortunate background. A background I must learn to live up to.
lines.zh: : 眼下，我不过是个出身幸运的女孩。一个我必须学着去「配得上」的出身。

lines.en: : And to do that...I require your assistance.
lines.zh: : 而要做到那点……我需要你的帮助。

lines.en: scene toukavending32
: Not right now, though, since I have plans with my mother and my sister to play shuffleboard on the yacht this afternoon.
lines.zh: : 不过现在不行，因为我下午约了母亲和妹妹去游艇上玩沙狐球。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s really something I can assist with, so that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那事我帮不上什么忙，所以没关系。

lines.en: : I should probably be heading out anyway. I didn’t really expect to spend the entire morning re-educating a princess.
lines.zh: : 我反正也该走了。我本来没指望把整个上午都花在「重新教育一位公主」上。

lines.en: scene toukavending33
: Would it be too much to ask for you to not call me that?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……别那么叫我？……

lines.en: : That word bothers me even more than your compulsion to keep addressing me by different names.
lines.zh: : 那个词比你老换着名字叫我还要让我难受。

lines.en: : Uhh...sure. I didn’t really mean it as an insult.
lines.zh: : 呃……行。我其实没拿它当贬义。

lines.en: : Well, thank you for understanding then...
lines.zh: : 那么……谢谢你的理解……

lines.en: scene black
I get off the bench and move away from Touka.
lines.zh: 我从长椅上起身，走开了。

lines.en: I turn back after a few seconds to see if she’s leaving as well, but she remains still-
lines.zh: 几秒后我回头看她是不是也走了，可她还一动不动——

lines.en: Sipping on her box of peasant liquid (Which I’m sure is what she’s calling it in her head) and staring off into the distance...
lines.zh: 啜着她那盒「平民液体」（我敢肯定她心里就是这么叫的），望着远处出神……

lines.en: $ touka_love += 1
$ toukastreets1 = True
Touka’s affection has increased to [touka_love]!
lines.zh: Touka 的好感度上升到了 [touka_love]！

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
